verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 80.0 (-6.8% in a day) and momentum is 46: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 1,100 and 86s 2,200. The weekend is ending, and prices usually ease into Monday.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-16T05:50:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Camilo Durán 85 Star Performer after its 41% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 67,500 coins. Now 65,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 40.6% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 3 of 8 so far, averaging -0.8% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Debinha 88 Team of the week after its 38% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 101,000 coins. Now 104,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 37.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 10 of 17 so far, averaging +8.5% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Weekend is ending: wait before buying
moves.detail: Prices usually ease as the weekend ends and players sell their squads. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-19T07:59:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 1,100 (0.52 coins per Item Score point), 86s 2,200 (0.54 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,400 (1.16 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,500 (1.39 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 86s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Gianluigi Buffon and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Gianluigi Buffon 92 Base Icon -42.9%; Jobe Bellingham 77 Rare -37.7%; Adebayo Akinfenwa 86 Hall of FUT: Unleashed -36.7%; Barbara Bonansea 82 Rare -34.6%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Shea Lacey SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 41.6K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
